metrics.name: End-to-end strict acceptance
metrics.construct: Probability that one planned generation attempt yields a complete candidate accepted by the independent evaluator within the frozen budget.
metrics.population: All planned attempts in the frozen experiment design
metrics.denominator: All planned attempts; started- and completed-attempt sensitivities are reported separately
metrics.status_mapping: strict success=1; quality failure, abstention, cancellation, timeout, infrastructure failure, or not started=0
metrics.evidence: Versioned evaluator responses joined to the complete generation ledger

validation.method: Protocol, budget, and denominator reconciliation regression tests

metrics.limitations: Validity depends on the target verifier and evaluation suite; the bundled smoke evaluator checks integrity only

metrics.name: Candidate bundle integrity
metrics.construct: Whether the captured candidate bundle still matches its validated content digest and required artifact roles.
metrics.denominator: Generated candidates submitted to the evaluator
metrics.status_mapping: digest and role validation pass=true; validation failure=false; evaluator infrastructure failure=missing
metrics.evidence: Canonical response manifest, role paths, and content-tree digest
metrics.limitations: Integrity is not a measure of compilability, grading correctness, or educational quality
